name: Joshua Tree
tagline: Desert of twisted trees, giant boulders and starry skies
summary: Joshua Tree is where the Mojave and Colorado deserts meet, full of spiky Joshua trees and giant boulder piles. Scramble at Hidden Valley, watch sunset from Keys View, walk among glowing cacti at the Cholla Garden, and spend evenings in quirky desert towns like Pioneertown with its live-music saloon.
seasonNote: March to April for blooms, October to November for mild days; summer often tops 40°C.
arrival: Palm Springs airport is 1 hour; Los Angeles is about 2.5 hours.
gettingAround: A car; there is no shuttle or water in the park.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Desert cafés, date shakes and roadhouse BBQ.
buyTip: Vintage shops and desert art in Joshua Tree town.
baseArea: Joshua Tree town, Yucca Valley or Twentynine Palms
